Class DisplayUI

java.lang.Object
splendor.display.DisplayUI
public class DisplayUI extends Object
Handles all display output for the Splendor game. Every display method has two versions: - A print version that outputs directly to System.out (for local/offline play) - A get version that returns the same output as a String (for sending over sockets in multiplayer) Example usage in server code: broadcast(DisplayUI.getGameState(gameState)); sendToPlayer(name, DisplayUI.getReservedCards(player));
